calibration_rule: First floor(nrep/2) replicates; type8 0.95 quantile of absolute null z; remainder evaluated.
uncertainty: Available working intervals beta +/-1.96se; macro replicate average; no confidence-interval recalibration.
unidentified: All targets retained; missing coefficients count as no rejection; excluded only from conditional coverage with availability separately reported.
convergence: Raw files retain all returned fits. Primary derivation excludes explicit algorithm/selector nonconvergence; all-returned finite outputs are a sensitivity.
